DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP).

The initial workup shows a normal coagulation profile (PT, PTT) and a normal platelet count, which effectively rules out hemophilia, von Willebrand disease, and thrombocytopenia. Since the clinical presentation of spontaneous mucosal bleeding and petechiae is classic for platelet function disorders, I need to test platelet function specifically.
